dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Multiple prominent 'O' and 'C' shaped structures in the mid-dorsal region exhibit sharp, high-contrast transitions from dark charcoal backgrounds to bright off-white perimeters; these rings encircle darker interior centers with irregular, jagged geometry.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: A high concentration of solid, high-intensity white pixel clusters is located in the anterior-dorsal region near the neck; these clusters lack internal tonal gradients and are closely packed with minimal spacing.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of the three most distinct macro-annuli in the central dorsal region form an elongated scalene triangle oriented parallel to the longitudinal axis of the body.
